message.content: Build the Agent Activity Universe for BTW Buildathon 2026, E3 track: a 3D visualization of AI coding agents across a codebase, powered by Entire checkpoint context and Databricks analytics. Start with sample data, keep Entire central, avoid overengineering.

content.text: Plan: scaffold Vite+React+TS+Three.js app with a data layer (types, sample-data, adapter), 3D universe (file nodes, agent entities, connections), inspector panel, controls, and Databricks analytics layer. Follow the PDF plan: the 3D visualization is not the product itself; the product is understanding what agents do and where risk accumulates.
